name: desu
description: ない/なかった + です (polite negative). Ichiran suffix-desu; score is (constantly 200). *suffix-unique-only* predicate excludes じゃない (seq 2755350).

name: desho
description: ない + でしょう (polite presumptive negative). Ichiran suffix-desho; score is (constantly 300). Excludes じゃない.

name: kudasai
description: te-form + ください (please do ~). Ichiran suffix-kudasai; score is (constantly 360).

name: teiru
description: te-form + いる (progressive). Ichiran has TWO classes: :teiru+ (score 6, full kana form like いる/いた/いて) and :teiru (score 3, 1-char-stripped form like る/た/て used for the contracted てる/てた contractions). dict-grammar.lisp:212-215. Score field is :teiru+ for the regular suffix-compound path; stemStripScore=3 is :teiru used by BuildStemStripCompoundEdges for the contracted attached surfaces.

name: teii
description: te-form + いい/よい (permission). Ichiran suffix-teii.

name: sugiru-adj
description: adj-stem + すぎる (e.g. まぶしすぎる, 優しすぎ). Ichiran suffix-sugiru closure: root+い → find-word-with-pos adj-i. Same score 5.

name: chau
description: te-form contraction to ちゃう/ちまう/じゃう/じまう. Ichiran suffix-chau (:stem 1 :score 5). StemStrip=1 — the stem's て/で is absorbed into the attached surface.

name: toku
description: te-form + とく (contraction of ておく). Ichiran suffix-to (:stem 1 :score 0). StemStrip=1 — stem's て/で is absorbed into the attached's leading と/ど.

name: teiku-ct
description: te-form + てく (contraction of ていく). Ichiran registers short-form iku surfaces (く etc.) under :te class; we model the composite てく as a :stem 1 contraction so the て overlaps the stem's final te.

name: shimau
description: te-form + しまう. Ichiran suffix-chau class (score 5).

name: itadaku
description: te-form + いただく. Ichiran :te+space class (score 3).

name: nikui
description: masu-stem + にくい. Ichiran :ren- 2772730 :nikui (score 0). uniqueOnly per Ichiran *suffix-unique-only*.

name: gachi
description: masu-stem + がち. Ichiran :ren 2016470 :gachi (score 5). Productive suffix — attaches to any masu-stem per Ichiran's suffix-ren; no compound-lookup requirement.

name: gai
description: masu-stem + がい. Ichiran :ren- 2606690 :gai (score 0). uniqueOnly per Ichiran *suffix-unique-only*.

name: naku
description: adj-stem/masu-stem + なく. Ichiran :neg class — load-kf at dict-grammar.lisp:263 keys the class to the specific kana form なく of ない (seq 1529520), NOT every conjugation of ない. Without the surface restriction the rule over-fires on ない/なかった/なければ and drops the scorer into compound-text mode (using dict-form mora count instead of surface mora count), undervaluing plain verb+ない conjugations by ~2×.

name: rashii
description: V-past + らしい (apparent/seemingly). Ichiran suffix-rashii (dict-grammar.lisp:511) requires (find-word-with-conj-type root 2) — past-form. Synth-compound audit identified 4 V-past+rashii misses (参考にしたらしい +218, 教われたらしい +758, 決めたらしい +362, となったらしい +8) under the previous masu-stem stemType. The earlier comment about 参考にしたらしい over-merge was the inverse — past-form is needed to merge correctly.

name: sou
description: sou-base + そう. Ichiran suffix-sou (constantly (cond ((equal root 'から') 40) ((equal root 'い') 0) ((equal root '出来') 100) (t 70))). Root-sensitive scoring via stemScoreOverrides.

name: sou-nai
description: masu-stem + そうにない. Ichiran :sou+ class (score 1). Ichiran's def-simple-suffix for suffix-sou+ has no compound-existence gate.

name: rou
description: past-tense + ろう (probably/I guess). Ichiran suffix-rou: (find-word-with-conj-type root 2). AttachedSurface=ろう ports Ichiran's (load-kf :rou (get-kana-form 1928670 'だろう') :text 'ろう') restriction — the rule only fires against the 2-char truncation, not the full だろう entry, so 喜んだ/だろう splits as expected.

name: kurai
description: verb/stem + くらい/ぐらい. Ichiran suffix-kurai (score 3).

name: ra
description: pronoun + ら (plural). Ichiran suffix-ra. bridgeOnly: synthetic pronoun+ら edges are not exposed as standalone lattice segments — prevents 何か+ら from beating 何+から. Real lexical plurals (彼ら etc.) already exist as lookup/table edges and are unaffected.
